changeSet.createProcedure: create or replace function z_raporu(howmanydays character varying) returns TABLE ( id bigint, order_info character varying, firm_name character varying, baglanti_tipi character varying, alt_cari_adi character varying, belge_no character varying, op_type character varying, erp_order_info character varying, miktar bigint ) language plpgsql as $$ BEGIN RETURN QUERY SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY aom.order_info) AS id, aom.order_info, aom.firm_name, aom.baglanti_tipi, aom.baglanti_tipi AS alt_cari_adi, aom.belge_no, aom.op_type, aod.erp_order_info::character varying AS erp_order_info, aod.count AS miktar FROM aur_order_master aom JOIN ( SELECT aodd.aur_order_id, aodd.siparis_no AS erp_order_info, COUNT (*) AS count FROM aur_order_detail aodd GROUP BY aodd.aur_order_id, aodd.siparis_no ) aod ON aom.id = aod.aur_order_id WHERE (aom.created_date > (now() - howManyDays:: interval) OR aom.last_modified_date > (now() - howManyDays:: interval)) AND aom.status::text = 'DONE'::text ORDER BY aom.order_info, aom.op_type; END; $$;

changeSet.author: halil
changeSet.createProcedure: create view aur_vw_z_raporu (id, order_info, firm_name, baglanti_tipi, alt_cari_adi, belge_no, op_type, erp_order_info, miktar) as SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY aom.order_info) AS id, aom.order_info, aom.firm_name, aom.baglanti_tipi, aom.baglanti_tipi AS alt_cari_adi, aom.belge_no, aom.op_type, aod.erp_order_info, aod.count AS miktar FROM aur_order_master aom JOIN (SELECT aodd.aur_order_id, aodd.siparis_no AS erp_order_info, count(*) AS count FROM aur_order_detail aodd GROUP BY aodd.aur_order_id, aodd.siparis_no) aod ON aom.id = aod.aur_order_id WHERE (aom.created_date > (now() - '1 day'::interval) OR aom.last_modified_date > (now() - '1 day'::interval)) AND aom.status::text = 'DONE'::text ORDER BY aom.order_info, aom.op_type;
